prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, voluminous curls golden blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut school-swimsuit-style one-piece of ultra-thin matte navy spandex with wide shoulder straps, a white name patch with a small number on the left of her chest, thin white piping along the neckline and the leg openings, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to her belly button and the two sides of the spandex fully covering her bust, the leg openings cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her arms and legs bare, the swimsuit shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin and fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin spandex molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the white name patch and the thin white piping crisp against the navy, fine stretch lines and a soft matte sheen. Pose: sitting on the top of the giant cork with one leg stretched out long and the other knee bent, leaning back on one hand planted behind her, the other hand resting on her knee, chest lifted, chin raised, her legs fully in view — most extreme violin hip hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a party table in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic champagne cork with its gold foil and wire cage beside a giant green bottle, giant shiny confetti pieces and curled ribbons scattered around, giant gold balloons floating behind, a softly blurred party hall far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on top of the giant cork with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm festive light with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous champagne cork, confetti and balloons around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
